criteria.criterion: A duplicate allowlisted call returns the cached result without re-executing the tool; the wrapped tool function runs exactly once for N identical calls (unit test with a counting stub).
Nudge escalation: first repeat carries the level-1 static nudge, subsequent repeats the level-2 text; both byte-stable across runs (unit test).

The runaway guard still observes memoized duplicates: the distinct-ratio window sees every duplicate signature, and a synthetic loop still trips the actuator at the same call index with the memo active (unit test against the existing guard tests' fixtures).

Error results are not memoized: an allowlisted call whose return begins with "Error:" re-executes on the next identical call (counting stub returning an "Error:"-prefixed string, then a success), and carries no nudge (unit test).

Deterministic sentinel-empty results ARE memoized: a search_files-style stub returning "(no matches)" runs exactly once for N identical calls and the duplicate carries the repeat nudge (unit test) — the core waste case.
Only allowlisted read-only tools are memoized; record_criterion_verdict and any non-allowlisted tool always execute (unit test).

Live Bedrock capture recorded on this ticket: a run demonstrating either a nudge-broken loop (duplicate signature followed by a different next call) or a nudge->actuator escalation, with usage-log figures, backed by a durable in-repo artifact under docs/experiments/.
